clue.text: Sound out group retreats for the famous

indicators.note: sound out here means say the following words aloud and write down what is heard

parts.note: a group, as in a small terrorist or activist unit, is a CELL; the tide retreats, or EBBS

explanation.surface: Someone testing opinion as a band of people withdraws, all for the sake of the well known.
explanation.walkthrough: CELL EBBS said aloud sounds like CELEBS.
explanation.definitionFit: Celebs is the informal short form of celebrities, people who are well known to the public.

clue.text: Woman set off in yacht

indicators.note: set off suggests things launched or scattered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman sets out to sea on a yacht.
explanation.definitionFit: Cynthia is a woman's given name, also an epithet of the moon goddess.

clue.text: Bet against queen making film

parts.note: in betting, to lay is to bet against a horse winning
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the queen

explanation.surface: A gambler betting against the queen in order to make a movie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'film' is a thin coating, not a movie.
explanation.definitionFit: A film is a thin covering on a surface, such as a coat of paint.

clue.text: Scoundrel creates wicked home for liberal arts

indicators.note: home for means the first word houses the rearranged letters

parts.note: wicked means BAD

indicators.note: liberal means free or loose, so the letters of arts are rearranged

explanation.surface: A villain building an evil base for the humanities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'liberal arts' looks like one phrase; 'liberal' rearranges ARTS into STAR, housed in BAD.
explanation.definitionFit: Bastard is a coarse insult for a dishonest or contemptible man, a rogue.

clue.text: Cats without a skin retreating inside, where they're never seen

indicators.note: inside tells us the reversed piece goes into the remaining letters of the first word
without means the letter A is removed from the word Cats
retreating means the synonym for skin is read backwards

parts.note: an animal's skin or coat is its FUR

explanation.surface: A description of cats with their coats peeled back, followed by a place where cats never appear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cats' looks like the subject, but the answer is a dog show. 'without' leaves CTS and 'retreating' gives RUF.
explanation.definitionFit: Crufts is the famous British dog show, so it is the one animal show where felines are never exhibited.

clue.text: Slow down — consider putting in time for golf

indicators.note: putting in tells us to insert a new letter into the word
for here means the new letter stands in place of the old

parts.note: to consider is to REGARD
G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Advice to slow the pace of a golf round by thinking things over.
explanation.definitionFit: To retard is to delay or hold back progress, as in retarding a reaction.

clue.text: Pays for machine to make furniture

parts.note: to foot the bill is to pay, so pays for is FOOTS
a machine tool, or simply a TOOL, is an instrument

explanation.surface: Someone paying for a machine to build some furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A footstool is a low stool for resting feet on, an item of furniture.

clue.text: Material building up as temperature drops

indicators.note: drops means the letter is let fall out of the word

parts.note: building up items one on another is STACKING them

explanation.surface: Fabric accumulating while the weather cools.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacking is coarse woven fabric such as hessian, used for making sacks.

clue.text: Doctor made realities go away

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A doctor making facts vanish.
explanation.definitionFit: To dematerialise is to vanish or cease to have physical form.

clue.text: Just downplay occasional absences

indicators.note: occasional absences means letters go missing at regular intervals, leaving every other letter of downplay

explanation.surface: Simply minimise the odd times someone isn't there.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping the first, third, fifth and seventh letters of DOWNPLAY leaves the even ones, O, N, L, Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Just in the adverbial sense of merely is a synonym of only, as in 'just one more'.

clue.text: Incurred expenditure on behalf of church that's no longer influential

definitions.note: a relative clause standing for the noun phrase 'something that is no longer influential'

parts.note: to incur expenditure is to have SPENT money
on behalf of someone means FOR them
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Money laid out for a church that has lost its sway.
explanation.definitionFit: A spent force is a person or movement whose power and energy are exhausted, now without sway.

clue.text: Guide plays her party piece

indicators.note: piece means a part cut from the words plays her party, letters running consecutively across them

explanation.surface: A tour guide performing her party piece at a gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across playS HER PArty.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherpas are Himalayan people famous as mountain guides and porters on Everest expeditions.

clue.text: Socratic version of what 16 across is

definitions.note: the clue for 16 across spells KIEV from the initial letters of its words

indicators.note: a version of a word is a different rendering of it, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A version of Socrates' method describing another clue in the puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: 16 across, KIEV, takes the first letters of 'keen investors exploiting venture'.
explanation.definitionFit: An acrostic is a text whose initial letters spell a word, exactly how the 16 across clue works.

clue.text: Fantastic price made one want to do it now

indicators.note: fantastic suggests something wildly fanciful, signalling that these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A shopper seeing a bargain price and feeling compelled to buy at once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one want to' is surface padding joining fodder to definition; several solvers found it superfluous.
explanation.definitionFit: Carpe diem, Latin for 'seize the day', urges acting at once rather than waiting for later.

clue.text: Pressure to withdraw conservationists? It's happened before

definitions.note: a clause standing for 'something that has happened before'

parts.note: to withdraw or pull back is to RECEDE
NT is the National Trust, a British conservation body

explanation.surface: Lobbyists pushing environmentalists to back off, as has happened before.
explanation.walkthrough: The National Trust looks after historic houses and countryside in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A precedent is an earlier case serving as an example, something that has occurred previously.

clue.text: Raised stink with US Republicans taking North back

definitions.note: a stink that has been raised; the adjective only colours the noun

indicators.note: back here means the combined letters are read in reverse order
taking means the party abbreviation takes in the letter for North

parts.note: GOP, the Grand Old Party, is the US Republican Party
N is the compass abbreviation for North

explanation.surface: American Republicans kicking up a fuss over the North.
explanation.walkthrough: GOP takes in N to make GNOP; 'back' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: Pong is informal British slang for a bad smell, a close synonym of stink.

clue.text: Foremost of keen investors exploiting venture capital

indicators.note: foremost of means the leading letter of each following word is taken

explanation.surface: Eager investors chasing venture capital funding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks part of the finance phrase 'venture capital' but is the definition on its own.
explanation.definitionFit: Kiev (now usually Kyiv) is the capital city of Ukraine.

clue.text: Monarchy lacks good family relations

definitions.note: plural phrase for the singular mass noun describing family ties

indicators.note: lacks means a letter is missing from the word

parts.note: monarchy is rule by a king, KINGSHIP

explanation.surface: A royal house without decent family ties.
explanation.definitionFit: Kinship is the state of being related by blood or marriage within a family.

clue.text: By embracing life at sea, it doesn't seem as long!

indicators.note: embracing means the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: by as in multiplication, three by four, is TIMES

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sailor finding life on the ocean passes quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'By' means multiplied by, as in three by four; 'at sea' gives EFLI.
explanation.definitionFit: The saying 'time flies' means hours pass quickly, so a stretch of it seems shorter than it is.

clue.text: Film tricks that capture the sound of fox dispatching duck

indicators.note: the sound of means the letters left are spoken aloud

parts.note: fox getting rid of duck, the cricket score of nought (O), leaves FX

explanation.surface: Cinema trickery recording the noise of a fox killing a duck.
explanation.walkthrough: FOX without O leaves FX, which spoken is EFF-ECKS.
explanation.definitionFit: Special effects, written FX, are the visual and sound illusions used in films.

clue.text: Record that is covering turf event

parts.note: EP is an extended-play record

indicators.note: covering means the first pieces wrap around the second

parts.note: a SOD is a piece of turf

explanation.surface: A recording made of turf laid at an event.
explanation.definitionFit: An episode is an incident or occurrence, one distinct event in a sequence.

clue.text: Can staff have character that's heartless?

parts.note: a can is a TIN
to staff a post is to MAN it

explanation.surface: Asking whether a company's employees can be cruel.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tin Man in The Wizard of Oz wants a heart.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tin Man of Oz goes looking for a heart because he has none.

clue.text: Not recognising central unit's position during trade

parts.note: during something is IN it

indicators.note: position means the middle letters are placed within the phrase for during trade

parts.note: a trade or transaction is a DEAL

indicators.note: central means the middle letters of unit are taken

explanation.surface: Failing to see where the main component sits in a business transaction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'central' picks the middle pair of letters; 'position' puts them inside the during-trade phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in denial refuses to acknowledge or accept an unwelcome truth.

clue.text: Complete brief for substitute

definitions.meaning: to complete a form is to fill it in
to brief someone is to fill them in on the facts

explanation.surface: Finish a short summary prepared for a replacement.
explanation.walkthrough: Three definitions: two verbs and a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Fill in serves as completing a form, updating someone with news, and as a stand-in.

clue.text: Identify first murder victim found by lake

parts.note: L is the map abbreviation for lake
in Genesis Abel, killed by his brother Cain, is the first murder victim

explanation.surface: Naming the first victim of a killing whose body turned up by a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: To label something is to name or tag it, marking what it is.

clue.text: Uses the mic flexibly to provide record of score

indicators.note: flexibly means the letters are bent into a new order

explanation.surface: A singer handling the microphone loosely to give a recording.
explanation.walkthrough: 'score' looks like a tally but is the musical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheet music is the printed notation of a musical score, a written record of it.

clue.text: Judges, for example, to me must be united

definitions.meaning: Judges is one of the ... of the Old Testament
joining the words to and me gives a single word for a large volume

explanation.surface: A demand that a panel of judges join the speaker's side.
explanation.walkthrough: Uniting TO and ME gives TOME, another word for the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A biblical part like Judges is one of the Bible's books, and a tome is a weighty volume.

clue.text: Plain case has lost ivory top

indicators.note: has lost means a letter is taken out of the word for case

parts.note: a doctor's case is a PATIENT

indicators.note: top means the first letter of ivory

explanation.surface: A plain box has lost its ivory lid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case' looks like a box but is a medical case.
explanation.definitionFit: Patent as an adjective means obvious or evident, which is what plain means here.

clue.text: Legendary lover admitted dealing in drugs

parts.note: an admission is said in the first person, I
dealing in goods means having SOLD them
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A storied romantic confessing to drug dealing.
explanation.walkthrough: The admission reads 'I sold E', with E for ecstasy.
explanation.definitionFit: Isolde is the heroine of the medieval romance of Tristan and Isolde, a famous pair of lovers.
